NFR-02.title: Responsive field interface
NFR-02.requirement: On the reference device, local field saves shall complete within 500 ms at the 95th percentile and cached patient or task screens within 2 seconds. Connected core screens shall target 3 seconds at the 95th percentile under the reference network.
NFR-02.acceptance: Verification: Instrument representative tasks under R1 load and report failed requests and slow outliers, not just averages.

NFR-05.title: Duplicate-safe execution
NFR-05.requirement: Repeated delivery, retries and replay of the same logical action shall not create duplicate business events where the connector contract supports idempotency or reconciliation. Unsupported cases shall remain unresolved instead of being blindly retried.
NFR-05.acceptance: Verification: At least 10000 replay and timeout test events produce no duplicate accepted activity in the supported connector fixtures.

NFR-09.title: Online revocation
NFR-09.requirement: Role removal or account suspension shall stop new online access and actions within 5 minutes. A disconnected device is constrained by its offline grant and local lock policy; it cannot be promised immediate remote revocation.
NFR-09.acceptance: Verification: Session, background job and reconnect tests enforce the limit and record the residual offline window.

NFR-10.title: Audit completeness and timing
NFR-10.requirement: All mandatory audit events shall be durable before or atomically with the consequential action where feasible. If durable audit cannot be established, external writes and privileged changes shall stop. Local capture may continue with its local audit queue.
NFR-10.acceptance: Verification: Audit-store failure blocks the designated actions, while recovery preserves event order and detects clock skew.

NFR-13.title: Accessibility
NFR-13.requirement: Web workflows shall target WCAG 2.2 AA; mobile workflows shall implement corresponding applicable principles and native accessibility support [S6]. Essential tasks shall support readable scaling, labelled controls, focus navigation and non-colour status cues.
NFR-13.acceptance: Verification: Automated assessment plus manual assistive-technology and representative-user testing covers all core journeys.
